definitions.full: H5520. sok [ סֹךְ ] noun [masculine] thicket, covert, lair ; — only suffix סֻכּוֺ Jer 25:38 lair of ׳י , under figure of lion (but Gie סֻבְּכוֺ compare 4:7 ), סֻכֹּה Psa 10:9 of lion (simile of wicked; Bae סֻכָּה ; Lag Che We סֻבְּכוֺ ); סוּכּוֺ 76:3 his covert (of ׳י under figure of lion; || מְעוֺנָתוֺ ); for סֻכֹּה in his covert 27:5 Qr read perhaps, with Kt סֻכָּה a booth (Ol Hup-Now Bae compare 31:21 ).
